_about: The ESRS quantities this platform holds, one concept per quantity, and where each version's printed datapoint (data/reference/regspec/esrs/<version>.json, item id : datapoint key) is filled from. A concept keeps its key across versions, so a figure reported under one version is the comparative under the next (ESRS 1 §83). Lanes: computed = the platform's engine; provided = the undertaking's own figure, attested by a second person (provided_datapoint, per undertaking and period); derived = a ratio the application requirements define from other concepts; same_as = a summary point whose figures are the concepts listed. input_only concepts are denominators from the financial statements, never printed by themselves. Every field datapoint of every version must be bound here (services.governance.esrs_binding.coverage). A concept bound in two versions is the same quantity by the texts (same quantity, boundary and qualifiers — noted in same_across_versions where the wording differs); a quantity the later version redefines is its own concept (redefined_from, why_separate), so it is never shown as the other's comparative (ESRS 1 §95).
